productName: West Lake Toddler Bed Rail Kit
description:
Transition your little one to your crib into a toddler bed with this West Lake conversion kit. Made specifically for the West Lake crib, this conversion kit offers a smooth and safe transition from crib to bed.

Premium solid hardwood with West Lake's signature BrownMaple finish. Easy installation with included hardware.
